The following economic technologies become available: * Fertile Crescent (Age II) * Agriculture (Age III) * Improved Processing (Age IV)|In-game description}} The '''Economic Wing''' is an [[Age]]-up [[Technology (Age of Empires IV)|technology]] for the [[Abbasid Dynasty]] in ''[[Age of Empires IV]]'' that can be researched at the [[House of Wisdom]]. It advances the player to the next Age, except when researched in the [[Imperial Age (Age of Empires IV)|Imperial Age]], and adds +5,000 hit points to the House of Wisdom. Additionally, it allows the research of new technologies. == Additional technologies == {| class="fandom-table" !width=25%|{{4icons|Feudal Age|48}} !width=25%|{{4icons|Castle Age|48}} !width=25%|{{4icons|Imperial Age|48}} |- |{{4icons|Fertile Crescent}} - Cost of economic buildings and Houses is reduced by 30% |{{4icons|Agriculture}} - [[Villager (Age of Empires IV)|Villagers]] gather from [[Farm (Age of Empires IV)|Farms]] 15% faster |{{4icons|Improved Processing}} - Villagers drop off 8% more resources |} == Strategy == Ageing up to the Feudal Age with the Economic Wing lays the foundation for a strong multiple [[Town Center (Age of Empires IV)|Town Center]] boom. One of the biggest risks of building additional Town Centers is their large upfront cost, which can be reduced significantly with the Fertile Crescent technology and make Town Centers pay off faster. This also synergizes well with the [[Fresh Foodstuffs]] technology, as it also mitigates a portion of the food investment needed to sustain [[Villager (Age of Empires IV)|Villager]] production. The cost of the larger amount of Houses and drop-off buildings that naturally come with a multiple Town Center boom is also reduced, allowing the player to jump to building military or advancing to the Castle Age sooner. The Economic Wing can also help with transitioning into a mid to late game economy, especially with reducing the cost of [[Farm (Age of Empires IV)|Farms]] needed for a Farm transition later on in the game and improving their output. == Further statistics == {{Boosts|Technologies |Size = 60 |Cost = {{4icons|Preservation of Knowledge}} (-20%, requires {{4icons|Culture Wing}}) }} == Changelog == === {{4icons|AE|30}} === * With [[update 6.0.878]], [[Fresh Foodstuffs]] was moved to the [[Town Center (Age of Empires IV)|Town Center]] and replaced with the new technology 'Fertile Crescent'. == Campaign version == The House of Wisdom appears as the primary landmark in the [[The Sultans Ascend (campaign)|The Sultan's Ascend]] campaign. It behaves like the Abbasid House of Wisdom, with each Wing unlocking new technologies per Age. However, the Economic Wing has the following differences from the standard version: * The Feudal Age technology is [[Food Reserves]] instead of Fertile Crescent. * The Castle Age technology is [[Berry Cultivation]] instead of Agriculture. == Gallery == House of Wisdom Economy Wing AoE4.png|The House of Wisdom when reaching the Feudal Age using the Economic Wing {{Age up (Age of Empires IV)}} [[Category:Abbasid Dynasty]] [[Category:Age-up technologies (Age of Empires IV)]]
